name: UnicodeData

source.verification: unicode.org HTTPS distribution (2026-09-01). The extracted files were confirmed to have the same SHA-256 as the individual distribution files in the same directory (2026-11-12). Unicode provides no signatures.

notes: Only the files used to generate and test the Unicode normalization, simple case folding, General_Category and Default_Ignorable tables were extracted byte for byte from UCD.zip (unused UCD files are not kept). Design: Docs/Design/CoreDataFoundations.ko.md section 1.
license.txt was downloaded from outside the UCD directory (https://www.unicode.org/license.txt) (licenseSource).
The generated table (Core/Source/Runtime/Core/Private/Text/UnicodeTables.generated.h) goes into Core, so embeddedIn = Core; an SDK that contains Core distributes this license.
